items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.author: cloudflare
items.summary_zh: cloudflare/security-audit-skill 是一个把 coding agent 变成安全审计员的 skill，编排隔离的 Agent 依次完成侦察、覆盖驱动狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录核验和目标无关报告六个阶段。它是 Cloudflare 漏洞发现 harness 的起点版本，产出的 findings 经过独立验证且机器可读，适合想搭自动化漏洞挖掘流程的安全团队。
items.summary_en: cloudflare/security-audit-skill turns a coding agent into a security auditor, orchestrating isolated agents through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification and target-neutral reporting. It is the single-repo skill that seeded Cloudflare's fleet-wide vulnerability discovery harness, and it writes independently verified, machine-readable findings to files like findings.json. Security teams building automated vulnerability-hunting pipelines are the intended audience.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者记录了自己从 Cursor 转向 Codex、用了大半个月之后的体验：Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的冲击，而 Codex 更像一个能自己往下做事的超级 Agent，而非单纯的编程助手。这是主观使用感受而非基准测试，适合正在 Cursor 和 Codex 之间做选择、或关心 AI 编程工具形态往哪走的人参考。
items.summary_en: A developer who spent the better part of a month on Codex after switching from Cursor says the newer tool feels less like a coding assistant and more like a general-purpose agent that keeps working on its own, while Cursor was his first real taste of AI-assisted coding. It is a personal, hands-on account rather than a benchmark, useful for anyone choosing between the two or tracking how these tools are changing shape.

items.title: 企业 AI 越用越复杂，如何用一个 Gateway 管好模型、Agent 和成本？｜ 技术趋势
items.summary_zh: Snowflake 的 Cortex AI Gateway 已进入公开预览，定位在企业 AI 客户端与其访问的后端系统之间，作为集中式控制平面，通过单一端点提供受治理的模型推理、动态模型路由、MCP 工具治理、可观测性、安全护栏与成本归因。文章认为企业 AI 栈碎片化的根源不是工具不够，而是缺少这样一层控制节点，适合负责 AI 平台治理与成本管理的团队阅读。
items.summary_en: Snowflake's Cortex AI Gateway has entered public preview, positioned as a control plane between AI clients and the enterprise systems they reach, offering governed model inference, dynamic model routing, MCP and tool governance, observability, guardrails and cost attribution through a single endpoint. The article argues that fragmentation in enterprise AI stacks comes from a missing control layer rather than a shortage of tools, and targets platform teams responsible for governance and spend.

items.title: [分享发现] 来了一个到处搬运帖子起号的用户：@cjkcjkcjk
items.summary_zh: V2EX 上有用户指出 @cjkcjkcjk 是一个到处搬运站内帖子来起号的账号，正文列出了该账号近期搬来的多条帖子标题和发布时间，跨度从几小时前到四五天前，内容从「年轻人的出路在哪里？」「结婚三年，现在跟我说不生小孩，我该怎么办？」到「vps 的 IP 送中了能用来给 Claude 做代理么？」都有。相当于给常逛站内的人提个醒，注意这类批量搬运账号。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user flags @cjkcjkcjk as an account that mass-reposts threads from across the forum to build up a profile, listing copied titles and their posting times, which range from a few hours to about five days old. The examples run from career advice and marriage questions to a VPS-and-Claude proxy query, giving regulars a concrete way to recognize this kind of repost farming.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章讨论 2026 年技术面试的变化：两年前还在考手写 Promise、React Fiber 原理，如今面试官默认候选人会用 AI，转而追问「AI 能写 80% 的代码，公司为什么还需要你」。文章要回答的正是开发者该展示哪些 AI 替代不了的判断力和工程能力，适合正在准备面试的工程师。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post on how 2026 technical interviews differ from two years ago: instead of hand-writing a Promise or explaining React Fiber, interviewers now assume candidates already use AI and ask why a company should still hire them when AI writes 80% of the code. It's aimed at engineers preparing for interviews who need to articulate what AI can't replace.

items.title: 又一国产决策模型发布：面向企业高频判断任务，23 项开源基测准确率超过微软和 JEV
items.summary_zh: 蚂蚁数科 10 月 22 日发布决策模型 LingDT-Decision-1.0，提供 4B 与 27B 两个版本，专做意图识别、任务分类、工具选择与风险判断等结构化判断，已在 DTMaaS 平台限时免费开放体验。官方称其 27B 版本在 23 项开源基准的综合评分超过 Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.0 与 Fastino/GLiDE，在客服等场景 Token 消耗降低九成以上、处理速度最高提升约 10 倍。
items.summary_en: Ant Digital Technologies released LingDT-Decision-1.0 on October 22 in 4B and 27B sizes, aimed at structured enterprise decisions such as intent detection, task classification, tool selection and risk scoring rather than free-form text generation. The company says the 27B version outscores Microsoft-Decision-1, Jev 1.13.0 and Fastino/GLiDE across 23 open benchmarks, with over 90% lower token use and up to 10x faster processing in customer-service and labeling tests. It is free to try for a limited time on the DTMaaS platform.

items.title: [分享创造] [跪求点进来看看] iPhone 保存视频太麻烦？在线下载工具， YouTube / B 站 / 小红书 / 推特链接粘贴就能下
items.summary_zh: V2EX 用户耶格尔做了一个免安装的在线视频下载站，浏览器打开、粘贴链接后由服务端解析直接下载，支持 YouTube、B 站、微博、小红书、X、Instagram 等平台，整段带文案的分享内容粘进去也会自动提取链接。作者说自己被 iPhone 存视频折磨多年才动手做这个工具，目前免费开放并征集反馈，还声称 91 和 P 站同样能下。
items.summary_en: A V2EX developer posting as 耶格尔 launched a browser-based video downloader that requires no app install: paste a link, the server parses it, and the file downloads. It covers YouTube, Bilibili, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, X and Instagram, and accepts whole share texts by pulling the URL out automatically. The tool is free and the author is soliciting feedback; the post also claims support for 91 and Pornhub.

items.title: [输入法] 搜狗输入法是限制词库导出了吗？
items.summary_zh: 一位 V2EX 用户想把搜狗输入法多年积累的词库导出来换到别的输入法，结果导出的 bin 文件只有约 400k，用深蓝转换工具打开后只剩几十条，而手机端词库同步显示约三万词。他换了老版本搜狗依旧如此，因此怀疑是官方故意限制导出，发帖询问是否有其他人遇到同样情况。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user trying to migrate years of accumulated Sogou IME vocabulary to other input methods found the exported bin file was only about 400KB, and converting it with the 深蓝 tool yielded just a few dozen entries, even though Sogou's phone-side sync shows roughly 30,000 words. Installing older Sogou versions gave the same result, prompting him to suspect the export is deliberately capped and to ask whether others are seeing this too.

items.title: 面向 Qwen 系列模型线性注意力的高性能优化实践
items.summary_zh: 本文整理自阿里巴巴 Qwen 团队算法工程师章程瑞东在 AICon 2026 深圳站的分享，介绍面向 GDN（Gated Delta Network）线性注意力的 GPU 算子库 FlashQLA。文章从线性注意力把复杂度由 O(N²d) 降到 O(Nd²) 的矩阵连乘推导讲起，覆盖序列并行、滑动窗口性质利用、硬件友好的代数改写与 warp specialization，并给出性能基准与生态集成进展。
items.summary_en: This write-up follows a talk by Alibaba Qwen team engineer Zhang Chengruidong at AICon 2026 Shenzhen on FlashQLA, a GPU operator library for GDN (Gated Delta Network) linear attention. It starts from the matrix-multiplication argument that takes linear attention from O(N²d) to O(Nd²), then covers sequence parallelism, exploiting sliding-window properties, hardware-friendly algebraic rewrites and warp specialization, closing with benchmarks and ecosystem integration.

items.title: [服务器] 接上次「x86 只涨 16%」：集邦说服务器 CPU 明年出货要涨 40% 以上，原因是一台 AI 机柜里 CPU 配得越来越多
items.summary_zh: 集邦 10 月 22 日预测，服务器 CPU 出货量 2026 年同比涨 31%、2027 年涨 40% 以上，理由是 AI 智能体调工具、查数据、跑代码都落在 CPU 上，机柜内 CPU 与 GPU/ASIC 配比会从 1:8 走向 1:2 甚至 1:1，同时给出 Arm 份额 2025 年略超 10%、2027 年约 30%，AMD 2026 年约 27% 的估计。发帖人是做服务器维保的，提醒出货量和收入是两回事：GPU 机器抬的是收入，CPU 出货涨抬的是台数，每颗 CPU 还带一整套 DDR5，所以服务器内存紧张不只关乎 HBM。
items.summary_en: TrendForce's October 22 forecast has server CPU shipments rising 31% in 2026 and more than 40% in 2027, arguing that AI agents doing tool calls, data lookups and code execution put the load back on the CPU, pushing rack-level CPU-to-GPU/ASIC ratios from 1:8 toward 1:2 or even 1:1. The same forecast puts Arm at just over 10% share in 2025 and about 30% by 2027, with AMD near 27% in 2026. The poster, who works in server maintenance, notes shipments and revenue are different things: GPU boxes inflate revenue, while CPU volume also drags along a full set of DDR5 per socket.

items.title: [程序员] 为什么很多人都把 DeepSeek 神化了，看不起国内豆包和其它 LLM？
items.summary_zh: 帖子里列了一组对比数据：月活方面豆包 4.2 亿、千问 1.7 亿、DeepSeek 1.2 亿、智谱 2000 万、Kimi 1000 万，ARR 方面豆包 272 亿、阿里 80 亿、智谱 68 亿、DeepSeek 27-34 亿、Kimi 20 亿，开源上 Qwen 放出 460 多个模型、衍生模型超 30 万、下载破 20 亿次。作者认为 DeepSeek 本身很强，但被捧成国内 AI 唯一的神，对阿里、智谱这些在开源上踏实投入的团队不公平，也忽视了字节那种靠抖音、飞书等产品矩阵托底、类似 Google 与 Gemini 关系的商业结构。
items.summary_en: The post lines up MAU (Doubao 420M, Qwen 170M, DeepSeek 120M, Zhipu 20M, Kimi 10M) against ARR (Doubao 27.2B, Alibaba 8B, Zhipu 6.8B, DeepSeek 2.7-3.4B, Kimi 2B) and open-source output, where Qwen has released over 460 models with 300,000+ derivatives and 2 billion downloads. The author's argument is not that DeepSeek is weak, but that crowning it the country's only AI god shortchanges teams like Alibaba and Zhipu that ship steadily in the open, and ignores the ByteDance structure where Doubao, like Gemini inside Google, is carried by Douyin, Feishu and a very large cash flow.

items.title: [分享创造] 超好玩，我把 GitHub 变成了可探索的星球游戏！我的星球超好看，那你的星球长啥样呢？
items.summary_zh: 作者用 Three.js 把 GitHub 账号数据渲染成一颗可探索的星球：不同项目变成不同岛屿，不同开发语言长成不同树木，私有项目化作深不见底的海洋，再加上建筑和生物点缀。用户可授权 GitHub 基础信息生成自己的星球，也可匿名生成，只是生态内容会少一些并标注未认领；项目里还埋了一个彩蛋。
items.summary_en: A side project that renders a GitHub account as an explorable planet in Three.js: each repository becomes an island, each programming language a kind of tree, and private repos turn into deep ocean, with buildings and creatures filling out the ecosystem. You can authorize basic GitHub info to generate your own planet or do it anonymously, which yields a thinner ecosystem marked as unclaimed. The author says an easter egg is hidden in the project for someone to find.

items.summary_zh: 开发者做了个免费的浏览器人生模拟游戏「80 亿分之一」，开局随机分配出生国家和家庭，之后在升学、工作、恋爱、移居等节点做选择，直到一生结束，无需注册打开网页即可玩。适合喜欢文字冒险和随机人生题材的人，作者也在收集体验反馈。

items.title: DeepSeek千亿融资逼近收官：结盟完美世界、中芯聚源等产业资本，募资翻倍押注具身智能

items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports DeepSeek's second round has locked in roughly 100 billion RMB at a pre-money valuation near 500 billion, pushing its total raised past 150 billion RMB in under four months. Tencent and CATL each added about 10 billion, while new money came mainly from hard-tech investors such as SMIC Capital and Geely, and Perfect World disclosed two vehicles that raised 11.17 billion combined.

items.title: 上下文语言模型：通过自主管理上下文提升性能、降低计算成本
items.summary_zh: Meta、MIT 与华盛顿大学提出上下文语言模型（CLM），把上下文当作可反复改写的文件，让模型自主删除无关信息、保留关键事实、记录进度，不再依赖摘要、压缩或检索。零样本下 BrowseComp-Plus 准确率提升 11.4% 且算力减少 21.5%，经强化学习训练的 Qwen3.5-9B 在同一基准从 28.8% 升至 42.5%。
items.summary_en: Researchers from Meta, MIT and the University of Washington propose Context Language Model, which treats context as a freely rewritable file: the model deletes irrelevant turns, keeps key facts and tracks progress instead of relying on summarization or retrieval. Zero-shot it lifts BrowseComp-Plus accuracy by 11.4% with 21.5% fewer FLOPs, and an RL-trained Qwen3.5-9B climbs from 28.8% to 42.5% on the same benchmark.

items.summary_en: iFlytek unveiled SparkAudio 1.0 on October 22, a speech foundation model that moves past ASR and translation to cover audio understanding, emotion recognition, real-time speaker separation and ambient sound. It also showed the cloud-device Spark X2.6 and a 4B on-device model, Spark-X2.6-4B. iFlytek says speech model calls are up more than 20x year over year and on-device models now handle roughly 70% of cloud capability, with the tech already shipping in iFlytek Input 16.0 for robots, cars and smart-home devices where several people talk over background noise.

items.summary_en: A Mozilla security blog post and Bugzilla bug 2083449 cover a compromise of an intermediate CA run by eMudhra. items.title: 决策模型也有专用推理引擎了：StartLux 开源 Prism，单卡最高提速 5.3 倍
items.summary_zh: StartLux 开源了为自家决策模型 StartLux-Decision 定制的推理引擎 Prism，在单张 NVIDIA H200 上跑 27B 模型时速度达到 vLLM 方案的 1.2 至 5.3 倍，同一份材料连答三问从 92.9 毫秒降到 17.4 毫秒。它只计算候选选项的概率而不生成整段文本，并保证相同请求输出逐位一致，12,351 次决策测试准确率 92.94%，与 BF16 的 92.97% 基本持平。
items.summary_en: StartLux has open-sourced Prism, an inference engine built specifically for its StartLux-Decision model. On a single NVIDIA H200 running the 27B model, it claims 1.2x to 5.3x the speed of vLLM, cutting a three-question task on one document from 92.9ms to 17.4ms. Because decision models only score a handful of candidate options rather than generate full text, Prism skips whole-vocabulary output and returns bit-identical results regardless of batching; accuracy was 92.94% against 92.97% in BF16.

items.summary_en: Gremlin has made Foresight AI generally available as an add-on to its reliability platform. The agent splits work across four roles — Analyst, Tester, Operator and Technical Program Manager — drawing recommendations from Failure Atlas, its record of millions of fault-injection experiments across tens of thousands of systems over a decade. It proposes a fix, then reruns the original test to verify it, and won't execute tests or apply changes without permission. Gremlin says customer data isn't used to train LLMs.

items.summary_en: Apple has introduced a JSON-based project format in Xcode 27.2, replacing the long-standing property-list project.pbxproj with a project.xcproj file. Apple also open-sourced the xcode-project-format spec and a Swift package for encoding and decoding it, so tooling can walk targets, build settings and dependencies. The more predictable representation produces readable diffs, fewer merge conflicts, and configs that AI coding agents can edit more reliably. Check that fastlane, CocoaPods and Tuist support it before migrating.

items.author: hkc
items.summary_zh: 安全研究者 Scott Helme 发现，eMudhra 一张中间 CA 证书的私钥就是数字 4，另外几张分别是 56 和 115；他在自己的笔记本上从公开证书里取回全部私钥，用时不到一秒。10 月 17 日有研究者向 Apple、Google、Microsoft、Mozilla 和 eMudhra 报告八张中间证书私钥泄露，Chrome 当晚推送 CRLSet 拦截，Firefox 数小时后经 OneCRL 屏蔽。
items.summary_en: Scott Helme recovered the private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate certificates straight from their public certificates in under a second, because the keys were tiny integers such as 4, 56 and 115. The compromise was reported to Apple, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla and eMudhra on 17 October; Chrome shipped a CRLSet block that evening and Firefox followed hours later through OneCRL.

items.summary_en: A Zhihu question asks readers to weigh in on Qilian County — home to roughly 50,000 people — receiving 100,000 visitors over the National Day holiday, with hotels and guesthouses fully booked and the local culture and tourism bureau putting visitors up free in student dormitories.
